description: A corked bottle of something olive and settled, sediment on the floor of it. Whoever kept it never opened it.
lore: It has stood still long enough to separate out: a clear finger under the cork, olive through the middle, and a floor of sediment that has not been stirred in a very long time. That is the sum of what anyone knows about the contents and it is not nothing. A bottle only settles like that if it is carried level and never once broached. Somebody had this for later, the whole way along a road, and later did not arrive.

Crackers will not draw the cork, and it is not nerves, it is arithmetic. Sealed, twenty-six gold. Open, it is a bottle. So it goes down the counters exactly as it came off the black rock and out of a [[monsters/malformed_creature|Palehusk]]'s grip, and every hand it passes through decides the same way, and the thing goes on being for later. [[characters/ef25b1f0|Bettany]] has asked three of the buyers who take them what they want them for. Two gave her nothing worth writing down. The third stopped coming.
gm_notes: The junk buyer, touched once and not resolved. A buyer who vanishes after one question is the cleanest hook in the batch; keep the contents of the vial undecided, since deciding costs more than it pays.
